displayDescription.en:
PaLM tested whether a single dense language model could be trained efficiently at 540 billion parameters using Google's Pathways system. The work used 6,144 TPU v4 chips and a 780-billion-token multilingual corpus, pairing systems engineering with a broad evaluation program.

As scale increased, PaLM improved few-shot language understanding, generation, reasoning and code tasks, while also showing discontinuous gains on some capabilities. The project became an important reference point for both large-model infrastructure and discussions of emergent behavior.
displayDescription.zh:
PaLM 检验了能否借助 Google 的 Pathways 系统高效训练一个 5,400 亿参数的稠密语言模型。该工作使用 6,144 个 TPU v4 芯片和 7,800 亿 token 的多语种语料，把系统工程与广泛评测结合起来。

随着规模增加，PaLM 在少样本语言理解、生成、推理和代码任务上持续提升，并在部分能力上出现不连续跃升。该项目因此成为大模型基础设施和涌现能力讨论的重要参照。

html.en: By 2022, scaling laws had encouraged ever-larger language models, but training them efficiently required new distributed systems. PaLM joined model research to Pathways, showing how one dense model could span thousands of accelerators.
html.zh: 到 2022 年，缩放规律推动语言模型持续增大，但高效训练这些模型需要新的分布式系统。PaLM 把模型研究与 Pathways 结合，展示了一个稠密模型如何跨越数千个加速器。

html.en: PaLM is a decoder-only Transformer trained on a multilingual mixture of text and code. Its key engineering result was efficient single-Pod-scale training across 6,144 TPU v4 chips, while the evaluation traced how capability changed up to 540 billion parameters.
html.zh: PaLM 是在多语种文本与代码混合语料上训练的仅解码器 Transformer。其关键工程成果是在 6,144 个 TPU v4 芯片上进行高效训练，同时通过评测追踪能力如何随规模增长到 5,400 亿参数。

html.en: Experts generally treat PaLM as a landmark in the co-design of large models and accelerator infrastructure. It also supplied influential evidence that some language-model capabilities can improve sharply rather than smoothly with scale.
html.zh: 专家通常把 PaLM 视为大模型与加速器基础设施协同设计的里程碑。它还提供了有影响力的证据，说明某些语言模型能力可能随规模出现跃升，而不是平滑增长。
